dedupe.result: All three additions are new to the ledger. The strong-field MCP theory is distinct from previously indexed nonlinear-Compton and QED-PIC observability studies; the MRX study is a new semi-collisional realistic-mass-ratio simulation-to-experiment reconciliation; and the Fusion Equilibrium Challenge is a new multi-machine benchmark rather than another deployed neural virtual-circuit controller.
